sentences: The rs6025 variant is a missense change in the F5 gene, NM_000130.4(F5):c.1601G>A (p.Arg534Gln), also known as Factor V Leiden [F2, F3].
The alternate T allele (C>T) is present on 2.2% of alleles in gnomAD v4 exomes, with frequencies ranging from 3.8% in Middle Eastern individuals to 0.0076% in East Asian individuals [F4, F5].
ClinVar's best-supported classification is Pathogenic for THROMBOPHILIA DUE TO FACTOR V LEIDEN, Factor V deficiency, Thrombophilia due to activated protein C resistance [F6].
ClinVar note: it also lists drug response, risk factor, Established risk allele assertions [F7].
